title_en: Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards by the People's Courts for the Belt and Road Initiative
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Construction of the Belt and Road Initiative

Fa Fa [2015] No. 9

The "Belt and Road Initiative" (the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road) is a major strategic decision made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as its core, proactively responding to profound changes in the global situation and coordinating both domestic and international situations. To fully leverage the trial functions of the people's courts and effectively serve and safeguard the smooth implementation of the Belt and Road Initiative, the following guiding opinions are put forward.

I. Unify Thinking, Raise Awareness, and Effectively Enhance the Sense of Responsibility and Mission in Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative

1. Deeply understand the significant importance of the Belt and Road Initiative and the important mission shouldered by the people's courts. The Belt and Road Initiative inherits and promotes the spirit of the ancient Silk Road of "peaceful cooperation, openness and inclusiveness, mutual learning, and mutual benefit," holds high the banner of peace, development, cooperation, and win-win, upholds the diplomatic concept of amity, sincerity, mutual benefit, and inclusiveness, and follows the principle of extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits. It aims to pool consensus and strength among countries to realize the "five connectivity" blueprint of policy coordination, facilities connectivity, unimpeded trade, financial integration, and people-to-people bonds, and to build a community of shared interests, shared future, and shared responsibility featuring political mutual trust, economic integration, and cultural inclusiveness. The implementation of the Belt and Road Initiative will have realistic and far-reaching impacts on creating a new pattern of China's all-round opening up, promoting economic growth, and fostering peaceful development. In the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative, the rule of law is an important safeguard, and the role of the judiciary is indispensable. People's courts at all levels must thoroughly study and implement the major decisions of the Party and the state regarding the Belt and Road Initiative and the important expositions of General Secretary Xi Jinping, fully recognize the sacred duties they bear, consciously assume the mission of the times, and actively serve and integrate into the process of the Belt and Road Initiative.

2. Accurately grasp the connotation and basic requirements of judicial services and safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative. Actively respond to the judicial concerns and needs of domestic and foreign market entities participating in the Belt and Road Initiative, vigorously strengthen the trial work of foreign-related criminal cases, foreign-related civil and commercial cases, maritime cases, judicial review of international commercial and maritime arbitration, and cases related to free trade zones, so as to create a sound legal environment for the Belt and Road Initiative. Fully implement the principle of legal equality, adhere to the equal protection of the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties, and effectively maintain a regional cooperation environment of fair competition, good faith, and harmonious win-win. Fully coordinate and find the combination points and focal points of the work of the people's courts and the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative, study regularities, highlight foresight, and be innovative, comprehensively improving the level of foreign-related trial work of the people's courts. Based on China's actual conditions, unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, actively carry out international judicial cooperation and exchanges with countries along the route, and consolidate the legal foundation for the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative.

II. Fully Leverage the Trial Functions, Enhance the International Credibility of Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative

3. Fully leverage the function of criminal trials to create a harmonious and stable social environment for the Belt and Road Initiative. Strengthen criminal trial work, deepen criminal judicial cooperation with countries along the Belt and Road, severely crack down on violent terrorist forces, ethnic separatist forces, and religious extremist forces, and severely punish transnational crimes such as piracy, drug trafficking, smuggling, money laundering, telecom fraud, cybercrime, and human trafficking. Properly adjudicate criminal cases in areas such as international investment, international trade, cross-border finance, ports, shipping, warehousing, and logistics, adhere to the principle of legality, strictly follow procedures, properly grasp the scale of criminal policy and the boundary between crime and non-crime, and ensure that every case stands the test of law and history.

4. Adjudicate cases related to the Belt and Road Initiative fairly and efficiently, creating a fair and just business and investment environment. Closely monitor international economic cooperation such as the construction of the New Eurasian Land Bridge Economic Corridor, and in accordance with the law, promptly adjudicate foreign-related civil and commercial cases concerning infrastructure construction, economic and trade exchanges, industrial investment, energy and resource cooperation, financial services, ecological environment, intellectual property, cargo transportation, and labor cooperation, actively safeguarding the implementation of the "going global" and "bringing in" strategies. Closely monitor the construction of key ports, shipping hubs, and other maritime strategic passages, and in accordance with the law, promptly and properly adjudicate maritime cases related to port construction, shipping finance, maritime cargo transportation, and marine ecological protection, promoting the strategy of building a maritime power. Correctly understand and grasp the relevant provisions and policies of the free trade zone construction concerning "pre-establishment national treatment" and "negative list," properly handle the relationship between party autonomy and administrative approval, promptly revise and adjust relevant judicial policies, strictly limit the scope of finding contracts invalid, and promote opening up. Strictly implement the principle of equal protection for Chinese and foreign parties, adhere to equal litigation status, equal application of law, and equal legal liability for all types of market entities.

5. Exercise judicial jurisdiction in accordance with the law, providing timely and effective judicial relief for Chinese and foreign market entities. Fully respect the right of Chinese and foreign market entities to choose judicial jurisdiction by agreement in the context of the Belt and Road Initiative, reduce international conflicts in foreign-related jurisdiction through friendly consultations and in-depth judicial cooperation with countries along the route, and properly resolve issues of parallel proceedings internationally. Follow international treaties and international practices, scientifically and reasonably determine the connecting factors for cases involving countries along the route, exercise judicial jurisdiction in accordance with the law, while safeguarding China's judicial jurisdiction, also respect the judicial jurisdiction of countries along the route, and fully protect the litigation rights of Chinese and foreign market entities in the Belt and Road Initiative. Strictly implement the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Case Registration and Docketing by People's Courts, accept all complaints for cases related to the Belt and Road Initiative that should be accepted according to law, register and docket them on the spot, render judgments as soon as possible according to law, and promptly resolve disputes. Further improve systems such as the identification of foreign parties, the examination of foreign evidence, and the testimony of foreign witnesses, to facilitate litigation for Chinese and foreign parties to the greatest extent.

6. Strengthen international judicial assistance with countries along the Belt and Road, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties. Actively explore strengthening regional judicial assistance, cooperate with relevant departments to introduce new model judicial assistance agreements in due course, promote the conclusion of bilateral or multilateral judicial assistance agreements, and promote the mutual recognition and enforcement of judicial judgments among countries along the route. In cases where some countries along the route have not concluded judicial assistance agreements with China, consider providing judicial assistance by Chinese courts to parties from those countries first, based on the intention of international judicial cooperation and exchange and the commitment of the other country to provide judicial reciprocity to China, actively promote the formation of reciprocal relations, and actively advocate and gradually expand the scope of international judicial assistance. Strictly follow the international treaties concluded or jointly acceded to by China and countries along the route, actively handle requests for judicial assistance such as service of judicial documents, taking of evidence, and recognition and enforcement of foreign court judgments, providing efficient and speedy judicial relief for the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties.

7. Accurately apply international treaties and practices in accordance with the law, accurately ascertain and apply foreign law, and enhance the international credibility of judgments. Continuously improve the judicial ability to apply international treaties and practices, and accurately apply international treaties and practices in cases where they should be applied according to law. Deeply study the trade, investment, finance, shipping, and other international treaties concluded or jointly acceded to by countries along the route and China, strictly follow the provisions of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, interpret in good faith according to the ordinary meaning to be given to the terms of the treaty in their context and in the light of its object and purpose, and enhance the uniformity, stability, and predictability of the application of international treaties and practices in case trials. In accordance with the conflict rules of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations and other relevant laws, comprehensively consider the foreign-related factors of the legal relationship, such as subject, object, content, and legal facts, fully respect the parties' right to choose the governing law, actively ascertain and accurately apply foreign law, and eliminate legal doubts of Chinese and foreign parties from countries along the route in international commercial exchanges. Pay attention to the differences in cultural and legal backgrounds of parties from different countries along the route, apply internationally recognized legal value concepts and principles such as justice, freedom, equality, good faith, rationality, order, strict observance of contracts, and estoppel, and provide reasoning and argumentation in a plain, concise, comprehensive, and rigorous manner, enhancing the persuasiveness of judgments.

8. Strengthen judicial review of arbitral awards involving parties from countries along the route in accordance with the law, and promote international commercial and maritime arbitration to play an important role in the Belt and Road Initiative. Correctly understand and apply the Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (hereinafter referred to as the New York Convention), promptly recognize and enforce foreign commercial and maritime arbitral awards related to the Belt and Road Initiative in accordance with the law, and promote mutual recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards with countries along the route that have not yet acceded to the New York Convention. Explore and improve the judicial review procedures for setting aside or refusing to enforce Chinese foreign-related, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan-related arbitral awards, as well as refusing to recognize and enforce foreign arbitral awards, unify judicial standards, and support the development of arbitration. Implement a unified and centralized working mechanism for judicial review cases of commercial and maritime arbitration to ensure uniform judicial review standards for commercial and maritime arbitration. Explore methods and approaches for the judiciary to support the effective functioning of international dispute resolution mechanisms such as trade and investment, ensure the performance of obligations under bilateral investment protection agreements, free trade area agreements, and other agreements between countries along the route, and support the resolution of disputes related to the Belt and Road Initiative through arbitration.

III. Establish and Improve Working Mechanisms to Create a Sound Legal Environment for the Belt and Road Initiative

9. Deepen reform, strengthen openness, and continuously enhance the international influence and credibility of foreign-related cases. Actively explore the responsibility system for presiding judges and collegial panels in handling cases, explore the centralization of new types of cases in foreign-related trial departments, and further leverage the advantages of specialized trials. In accordance with the spirit of the Fourth National Conference on Foreign-Related Commercial and Maritime Trials, promptly summarize the experience of pilot reforms in the maritime trial jurisdiction system, promote the inclusion of certain maritime administrative cases closely related to maritime affairs into the exclusive jurisdiction of maritime courts, effectively protect the marine economy and marine ecological civilization from the perspective of institutional mechanisms, and continuously consolidate China's position as a maritime judicial center in the Asia-Pacific region. Strengthen judicial openness, fully leverage the international window function of foreign-related justice, and continuously meet the right to know of Chinese and foreign parties. Study and formulate specific measures for the people's courts to accept applications from foreign citizens to observe court hearings, provide convenient conditions for foreign citizens to observe hearings, actively invite diplomatic envoys from countries along the route and international cooperation and exchange personnel to observe typical hearings, and respond to international concerns.

10. Establish a normalized research and guidance mechanism to enhance the systematicity and targeting of work. Treat the judicial safeguard for the Belt and Road Initiative as a routine task to be grasped firmly, combine short-term issues with long-term responses, combine specialized judicial safeguards with national overall promotion, combine judicial functions with central strategic planning and local realities, and promptly study the judicial needs and judicial policies in the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative. Deeply analyze and judge the characteristics and patterns of various cases related to the Belt and Road Initiative, strengthen judicial interpretation and case guidance, standardize discretion, unify the application of law, and timely provide guidance for market activities. Establish and improve a special statistical analysis system for cases related to the Belt and Road Initiative, publish typical cases, timely issue judicial suggestions and judicial information to relevant departments and the public, and effectively prevent legal risks. Establish communication and liaison mechanisms with national and local relevant departments, deeply study international law rules and the laws and regulations of countries along the route, propose forward-looking countermeasures, and enhance the overall synergy in promoting the Belt and Road Initiative.

11. Support the development of diversified dispute resolution mechanisms, and resolve disputes related to the Belt and Road Initiative in a timely manner in accordance with the law. Fully respect the voluntary choices of the parties based on factors such as politics, law, culture, and religion of countries along the Belt and Road, and support Chinese and foreign parties in resolving disputes through non-litigation methods such as mediation and arbitration. Further promote and improve the joint working system of commercial mediation, arbitration mediation, people's mediation, administrative mediation, industry mediation, and judicial mediation, leverage the advantages of various dispute resolution methods in resolving disputes related to the Belt and Road Initiative, and continuously meet the diverse needs of Chinese and foreign parties for dispute resolution.

12. Expand international judicial exchange and publicity mechanisms, and enhance legal recognition among countries along the route. Fully leverage existing multilateral cooperation mechanisms such as the Meeting of Presidents of Supreme Courts of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization, the China-ASEAN Chief Justices Forum, the Asia-Pacific Conference of Chief Justices, and the BRICS Chief Justices Conference, organize regional international judicial forums, jointly discuss and resolve issues related to the Belt and Road Initiative, and work with countries along the route to create a stable, transparent, fair, and just international legal environment for the Belt and Road Initiative. Promote the establishment of new mechanisms, further strengthen exchanges and cooperation between Chinese judicial institutions and those of countries along the route, establish a platform for the ascertainment of foreign law, support relevant domestic units to actively carry out legal exchange activities with higher education institutions and research institutions in countries along the Belt and Road, enhance the international community's understanding of Chinese justice, and promote mutual trust in the rule of law among countries.

13. Actively participate in the formulation of relevant international rules, and continuously enhance the international discourse power of China's judiciary. Further broaden international judicial exchange channels, closely monitor the progress of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the Silk Road Fund, promptly study the development trends of international law such as international financial law, international trade law, international investment law, and international maritime rules, and actively participate in and promote the formulation of international rules in relevant fields.

IV. Strengthen Work Guidance, Organizational Guarantees, and Information Technology Construction, Continuously Improve the Capability and Level of Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative

14. Strengthen experience summarization and work guidance to ensure that judicial services and safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative are solidly and orderly advanced. Fully leverage the enthusiasm of local people's courts at all levels, encourage local courts to base themselves on local realities, leverage their respective advantages, actively explore, create beneficial experiences, and promote the in-depth development of service and safeguard work. Based on the key points of the Belt and Road Initiative, strengthen key demonstrations and leverage their exemplary and leading roles. Pay attention to summarizing the experiences and practices of judicial safeguard work, and promote replicable and learnable advanced experiences and typical cases (incidents). Strengthen macro guidance, strengthen division of labor and implementation, do a good job in supervision and inspection and case evaluation, and continuously enhance the judicial safeguard capability for the Belt and Road Initiative.

15. Strengthen the training of professional talents, and continuously enhance the judicial capability commensurate with the Belt and Road Initiative. Formulate training plans, strengthen thematic and special training, and accelerate the establishment of a specialized trial team. Strengthen professional capability training, strengthen the learning of knowledge related to the Belt and Road Initiative, and enhance overall judicial quality. Expand the international vision of judges, encourage judges to participate in international exchanges, improve judges' ability to handle international affairs, and strive to cultivate a group of judges who can stand at the forefront of international legal theory and have international influence in the field of international civil, commercial, and maritime trials.

16. Strengthen information technology construction, and comprehensively improve the effectiveness and level of judicial services and safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative. Adhering to the principles of openness, transparency, convenience, efficiency, sharing, and connectivity, strengthen the top-level design of information technology for judicial safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative, adhere to innovation-driven development, promote the deep integration of information technology with trial business, the deep integration of information technology with judicial openness, and the deep integration of information technology with judicial convenience for the people, and build a network court, a sunshine court, and a smart court in line with the characteristics of the information age. Attach great importance to public opinion guidance and publicity work related to the Belt and Road Initiative, build English websites of the Supreme People's Court and foreign-related commercial and maritime trials, fully leverage new media technologies to publicize judicial services and safeguards for the Belt and Road Initiative, build a platform for foreign exchange and publicity, and provide timely, comprehensive, and detailed legal information related to the Belt and Road Initiative to the international community through various means, fully demonstrating the achievements of China's judicial construction and rule of law construction.

June 16, 2015
